# Zhe Wang — Academic Homepage

Zhe Wang is a PhD student in the Individualized Interdisciplinary Program at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, advised by Prof. Yuan Yao. His research covers AI for Science, AI-driven drug discovery, AI for chemistry, graph learning, and agentic research for scientific discovery.

Zhe Wang is open to research and industry opportunities in AI for Science (AI4Sci), LLM post-training, and recursive self-improvement (RSI), and to faculty positions in computer science or interdisciplinary fields.

For opportunities, contact Zhe Wang at zwangec@connect.ust.hk.

- [Full publication list](https://nickspark.github.io/publications.html): Published papers and arXiv preprints.
